wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 11-004 connects the player, monster, switch, door, pickup, teleport, and UI sound callback sites to the single vanilla s_sound.c S_StartSound entry point through one src/vanilla facade (wireSoundCallbackBridge.ts) re-exporting the read-only src/audio/soundSystem.ts: the value surface (startSound, NUMSFX 109, SFX_ID_MIN 1, SFX_ID_MAX = NUMSFX, START_SOUND_LINK_MIN_VOLUME 1, PITCH_CLAMP_MIN 0, PITCH_CLAMP_MAX 255) and the type surface (SfxPitchClass, StartSoundRequest, StartSoundResultKind, StartSoundResult, StartSoundStartedResult, StartSoundDroppedResult), split into value vs type re-exports under verbatimModuleSyntax (no const enums exist in soundSystem.ts). VANILLA_SOUND_CALLBACK_BRIDGE_INVARIANTS pins five rules: the sfx_id range includes the vanilla `<= NUMSFX` quirk (RangeError on out-of-range); the sfxinfo_t.link volume/pitch early-return precedes the audibility work; a remote origin routes through adjustSoundParams with the same-position NORM_SEP override before the audibility check; pitch perturbation is partitioned saw (8 - (M_Random() & 15)) / static (no perturbation, zero RNG advance) / default (16 - (M_Random() & 31)) then clamped to [0,255]; and the stopSound-then-allocateChannel slot reuse order is preserved. The focused test is inventory-neutral: constants, typeof startSound, the frozen five-rule manifest, the ../-filtered single-specifier set ['../audio/soundSystem.ts'], and a dynamic same-reference identity check against src/audio/soundSystem.ts (proving the wired startSound IS the SHA-pinned implementation, so its behavior holds transitively). The step became eligible with prerequisites 11-003, 09-004, and 10-005 COMPLETED.
